Chord voicings/audio (all chord midiNotes across all 12 roots x 17 qualities, plus the 12-bar-blues turnaround stock progression) — generated from standard chord-interval formulas and major-scale diatonic harmony, not sourced from any external corpus.

Progression sequences and mood tags (prog_maj, prog_min lists in chords.py — 50 major-key and 58 minor-key Roman-numeral degree/quality token sequences, each with mood tags) ported as text data. The actual chord voicings/pitches are this codebase's own generation (see duokeys-original-chord-catalogue); no MIDI files or audio from this repository are used.

Hanon exercises (The Virtuoso Pianist in 60 Exercises, Part 1, Charles-Louis Hanon, first published 1873) — scale-degree cell patterns re-derived as data, not parsed from any score file. Only exercise 1 is a verified transcription; exercises 2-5 are original approximations in the same style, honestly labelled in the UI as such (see src/core/content/hanon.ts); exercises 6-20 are deferred.
